pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0127 Native 2D first release
pr_body: Rebuilds the already-audited ADR0127 core, CLI/MCP parity, and runtime integration on current main in the exact previously successful edit order. The prior 87-part bundle was rejected by the documented producer 64-part limit; this request is the first protocol-compliant split and does not merge stale branches or PR #242.
